scenes.narration: In this video, we're going to talk about Maximum Everything: The Longest Allowed Title Wrapping Two Lines, a deliberately long title used to stress the layout engine at its limits. It keeps going for a while so the enumeration lands later. By the end, you'll see the longest learn bullet that is still allowed to wrap onto three lines, you'll see a second equally long bullet to fill the second card, you'll see a third bullet, you'll see a fourth bullet to force four columns.
